scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.verify:backend: npm run test:deployment && npm test --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run build:backend && npm run smoke:backend
scripts.railway:build: npm run prepare:database-ca && npm run build:backend
scripts.railway:release: npm run prepare:database-ca && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --workspace server
scripts.railway:migrate:status: npm run prepare:database-ca && npm run prisma:migrate:status --workspace server
